objects.taxonomy_description: Large wading bird measuring 120-145 cm in height with wingspan reaching 140-170 cm. Plumage ranges from pale pink to vivid scarlet depending on diet, with darker coloration on wings and tail. Neck is extremely elongated and S-curved, comprising approximately one-third of total body length. Bill is distinctive with downward-curving shape, deep black at tip transitioning to pale pink at base, adapted for filter-feeding. Legs are exceptionally long and bright pink to red with webbed feet. Body exhibits bilateral symmetry with compact torso contrasting elongated neck and legs. Wings display black primary feathers visible during flight. Flight posture features full neck extension. Juveniles display grey-white plumage developing pink coloration over 2-3 years. Weight ranges 2-4 kg.

objects.taxonomy_description: Stocky tailless marsupial measuring 60-85 cm in body length with robust rounded body form. Fur is dense, woolly, and grey-brown with distinctive white patches on chest, ears, and rump. Ears are large, rounded, and prominently furry with white marginal tufts. Nose is broad, leathery, and black with distinctive textured surface. Limbs are powerful with five digits each; forefeet feature two opposable thumbs for gripping eucalyptus branches. Claws are sharp and curved for climbing. Body exhibits stocky proportions with broad chest and rounded abdomen. Head is broad with small eyes and inconspicuous ears relative to body size. Weight ranges 4-15 kg with sexual dimorphism. Posture is typically upright when seated on branches.

objects.taxonomy_description: A manufactured play object characterized by artificial materials and non-biological structural features.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Structural_Joints: Presence of visible mechanical articulation points, seams, or molded lines that indicate assembly rather than natural anatomical growth.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Proportional_Accuracy: Body proportions are often stylized, exaggerated, or simplified compared to the realistic anatomical ratios of living organisms.
